title.text: Cartalith mobile shell · phone and tablet, every menu, any size

try.text:
How to try

· Hold GENERATE in the bottom bar: a fan offers WORLD, CIVIL and CARTO. Slide and release, or tap. Swiping the tab sideways cycles them; the sheet title (with ▾) opens the same fan.
· Each domain sheet has its nodes as chips, the node's tools, then every dock section as an accordion.
· MENU is the desktop menu bar: File, Edit, Assets, World, Story, Preferences, Window, Help, row for row.
· Long-press the map: sample pin and a card of actions for the current domain. Two-finger tap undoes, three-finger tap redoes.
· ⌕ finds places, factions, routes and runs any menu row, dock section or generation parameter.
· In the device lab: pick a size, rotate, press ◁ SYSTEM BACK, or drag the corner grip to any size up to 3840 dp.

changed.text:
What changes against today's phone

· CIVIL had no tab and CARTO lived behind MORE ▸ Window ▸ Left dock. Now one tab holds all three domains, with every dock section in its sheet.
· PLAN becomes STORY (Time · Journeys · Conflicts · Notes), the desktop Story menu. MORE becomes MENU, the desktop menus unchanged.
· The armed tool lives in one strip above the sheet: name, options, Commit / Discard. Tapping it opens the full options.
· Every control is at least 44 dp on both axes, measured. No painted status bar or gesture handle.
· The PC menu bar is untouched. Tablets show it whole from 1180 dp and as ☰ · File · World · Story below that, as shipped.

scale.text:
Scaling rules (all in dp, never pixels)

· Width under 600 → phone: bottom bar and a bottom sheet with peek, half and full detents.
· Landscape under 500 tall → phone landscape: the bar becomes a left rail and the sheet docks right, narrow or wide.
· Otherwise → the desktop shell with touch sizing. A dock stays docked only while the map keeps at least 520 dp; otherwise it floats over the map and can be pinned. Floating docks close when the map is touched.
· From 1920 dp the docks widen and the menu bar adds the desktop readouts. 4K runs at ×2, ×1.5 or ×1.
· UI scale (Touch & gestures) multiplies every dp on top of the OS density.

newworld.text:
New world, kept as shipped

File ▸ New world… keeps the shipped window (NWP-3, Ruling CE): the grey-on-blue land and ocean preview with its disclaimer, the seed row with Roll and Lock, a four-seed history, Extent, map width with plates scaled from it, resolution, the derived grid, archetype and More options. Two columns on a tablet; stacked on a phone.

New here, at the owner's suggestion: AUTO-POPULATE. One switch, then settlements (factions, territories), routes, names and labels, and landmarks and points of interest. Each runs an existing pass after the terrain is generated.
